jobs.title: Vice President of Finance
jobs.description:
ABOUT CODE METAL

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others. 
Learn more at codemetal.ai http://codemetal.ai.


THE ROLE:

We need a "builder" in the truest sense. You will be responsible for taking our current foundation and architecting a world-class finance function. You’ll be the right hand to the leadership team, ensuring we have the capital, discipline, and strategic insight to scale from $10M to $100M+.

This isn't a "sit back and manage" role. We need someone scrappy, hard-working, and deeply technical who isn't afraid to get their hands dirty with accounting entries one hour and lead a board-level strategic planning session the next.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Strategic Scaling: Lead the financial transition from an early-stage startup to a scaled enterprise, managing everything from bookings, backlog, and revenue forecasting to complex cap table management.

 - Operational Excellence: Build and oversee the entire accounting function (AP/AR, payroll, tax, audit). You’ll ensure our books are "Big Four" ready while maintaining startup agility.

 - Capital Allocation: Manage burn, optimize runway, and partner with the CEO on future fundraising rounds and investor relations.

 - AI-Driven Finance: Leverage your technical background to implement cutting-edge AI tools to automate internal workflows, making our finance department a model of efficiency.

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Engineering and Sales to align product milestones with financial targets and go-to-market strategies.


WHO YOU ARE:

 - Startup Veteran: You’ve been in the trenches. You have a proven track record of scaling a company from the $10M mark through significant growth phases.

 - Scrappy & Driven: You don't wait for a manual; you write it. You thrive in fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environments and possess a "no task is too small" attitude.

 - Big Picture & Detail Oriented: You can both speak to a long-range plan, but also put in place the operational building blocks to support the business through that growth.

 - Technically-Minded: You have a genuine interest in (or experience with) AI and deep tech. You can speak the language of our engineers and understand the unit economics of AI infrastructure.

 - Accounting Expert: You may have started in accounting or have a CPA, but more importantly, you understand the "why" behind the numbers and can build a robust compliance foundation.

 - Team-First: You are a low-ego, high-output collaborator who cares deeply about the mission and the people.


QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 10+ years of progressive finance experience, with at least 3+ years in a high-growth startup leadership role.

 - Deep expertise in core financial metrics & KPIs and hardware/edge-related business models.

 - Strong proficiency in modern finance stacks (e.g., NetSuite/Rillet, Rippling, Ramp, Mosaic, etc.).

 - Excellent communication skills - able to distill complex financial data into actionable insights for the Board and the team.


WHY CODE METAL?

 - Impact: You will be building the function from the ground up, driving our strategic direction, and supporting key decisions.

 - Innovation: We are solving some of the hardest problems in AI and hardware.

 - Culture: A high-intensity, high-reward environment where we value "the work" above all else.

Are you ready to build the financial backbone of the Edge AI revolution?


BENEFITS

 - Pay depends on experience, but we strive to be at the upper end of the salary range

 - Health care plan with 100% premium coverage, including medical, dental, and vision

 - 401k with 5% matching

 - Paid Time Off (uncapped vacation, plus sick and public holidays)

 - Flexible hybrid or remote work arrangement

 - Relocation assistance for qualifying employees



Wage Transparency - The salary range for this role is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as the final offer amount may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, individual proficiency, skills, experience, and location.


We are an equal opportunity employer. US Citizenship may be required for certain project assignments involving security clearance.



Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

ABOUT THE ROLE:


This role blends strategy, capture, relationship-building, and problem-solving. You’ll partner directly with company execs to inform, co-develop, execute, and lead Code Metal’s GTM strategy for the Navy. This role is ideal for someone who understands the current and emerging problems that the Navy faces and is excited to figure out how Code Metal can address those problems. You will quarterback engagements from introduction to contract execution, and navigate Code Metal through the service. You’re pumped about working at a dual-use company with proven AI, whose mission is to solve some of the government’s most urgent problems. You also crave everything from the national security mission to figuring out and rapidly getting on the best contract vehicle to enable delivery. At Code Metal, you’ll work closely with Deployment Strategists, product leads, fellow Growth leaders, and engineers. Our customers span the Pentagon, COCOM/MAJCOMs, and acquisition staffs.

We’re seeking a leader to drive Navy revenue growth—someone who can see around corners, put Code Metal in position as policy and acquisition priorities evolve, navigate complex programs, understand and explain our complex technology, and chart a growth path.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Define, lead, and execute the GTM strategy for Navy.

 - Maintain and further build relationships across the service.

 - Shape and turn opportunities into contracts.

 - Contribute to congressional engagements to ensure decision makers and influencers have accurate information on Code Metal execution and potential contribution to national security.

 - Anticipate and maintain status of relevant policy, budget, and acquisition shifts that open new opportunities.

 - Collaborate with technical teams to align Code Metal’s product with government needs.




REQUIREMENTS:

 - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience (MBA a plus).

 - Navy fluency.

 - Experience in business development, capture, or GTM leadership within government or defense technology sectors with a proven history of success.

 - Deep understanding of DOW acquisition, procurement, and team structures and processes.

 - Proven track record of expanding business, or getting the Navy bureaucracy to adopt a major, new initiative.

 - Demonstrated success driving multi-million-dollar defense programs or contracts.

 - Exceptional relationship building, communication, negotiation, and strategic planning skills.

 - U.S. Citizen required.




THE IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE EXPERIENCE IN THE FOLLOWING: 

 - Dept. of War component command, or joint logistics / operations roles

 - Defense policy, acquisition, or program management within DoW or other government agencies

 - Delivering growth outcomes for defense products, specifically in early-stage or dual-use technology environments

 


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

 - Active U.S. security clearance

 


TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.description:
ABOUT CODE METAL

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others. 
Learn more at codemetal.ai http://codemetal.ai.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Code Metal is growing quickly across Boston, San Francisco, Washington DC and distributed, and our People team is building the foundations to match. As our People Operations Generalist, you will own core day to day People Team execution: onboarding & offboarding, benefits and compliance, the employee lifecycle programs that run on our calendar, and the systems and data that underlie it all. You will report to our Director of People Operations and work closely with Recruiting, Business Operations, Finance, IT, and Security.

This role is for a builder. Many of our processes are still young, and you will have the agency and space to improve them and document them so they scale.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

 - Employee lifecycle execution. Own onboarding, offboarding, job changes, and background checks from signed offer to last day. Keep Justworks and our employee roster accurate so every system downstream can trust the data.

 - Execute our people programs. Run the operating side of our twice a year feedback cycle, compensation reviews, and new hire onboarding: timelines, manager packets, reminders, and the follow through that closes each cycle cleanly.

 - Administer benefits and leave. Be the first stop for benefits questions, run open enrollment and benefits execution, and manage leaves of absence.

 - Keep us compliant as we hire in new states. Own I-9s, required postings and trainings, state registrations, and handbook and policy updates. Partner with Security and our Facility Security Officer so our records meet the standards our government work requires.

 - Build the systems we'll grow on. Help evaluate the transition from PEO to HRIS, roll out new systems, and turn manual steps into documented, automated workflows.

 - Turn people data into answers. Build and maintain headcount, org, and program reports.

 - Be a trusted resource. Answer employee and manager questions with discretion, document processes, notice patterns, and fix the root cause when the same question comes up twice.



KEY SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years in People Operations or HR generalist roles, including time at a fast growing startup

 - Hands on experience running core HR/People operations on a PEO or HRIS

 - Working knowledge of U.S. employment compliance across multiple states, including Massachusetts & California

 - You've run execution for at least one people program end to end, such as open enrollment, a review cycle, or an onboarding program

 - Comfort in Google Sheets, reconciling data across systems and building reports, and storytelling with data

 - Strong judgment and discretion with confidential information, including knowing when to follow a policy and when to flag an exception

 - Excellent verbal & written communications and a warm, clear, and accessible communication and employee engagement style.


Nice to have

 - Experience at a defense, government contracting, or other regulated company

 - You've helped select or implement an HRIS or other complex software tool

 - Experience running communications for people programs, for example, rollouts, all hands segments, or manager toolkits

 - Automation, no code, or AI tools (Zapier, Google Apps Script, and the like) that take manual work off the team's plate


BENEFITS

 - Pay depends on experience, but we strive to be at the upper end of the salary range

 - Health care plan with 100% premium coverage, including medical, dental, and vision

 - 401k with 5% matching

 - Paid Time Off (uncapped vacation, plus sick and public holidays)

 - Flexible hybrid or remote work arrangement

 - Relocation assistance for qualifying employees



Wage Transparency - The salary range for this role is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as the final offer amount may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, individual proficiency, skills, experience, and location.
